title: Relief Allowed a Frequent Package Traveller on a Cancellation Penalty
content:
**What does the desk allow a traveller who books packages often?** The vacation packages desk allows a loyalty relief of 3 per cent, taken off the figure reached on a cancelled package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products. Whether the whole of that relief or half of it is taken turns on the record the Wanderlane Traveller Club ledger keeps.

**How is the record read?** The packages booked are the qualifying points entries the Wanderlane Traveller Club ledger records against the traveller from a package booking, counted over the last thirty-six months.

**When is the relief taken in full?** Where the club ledger shows the traveller has booked more than twice the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months — the threshold being 3 packages and the multiple being 2, so more than 6 packages — the desk's loyalty relief is taken off the figure reached in full, being 3 per cent of it.

**When is half of it taken?** Where the club ledger shows the traveller has booked more than the frequent-traveller threshold of packages in the last thirty-six months but no more than twice that threshold — more than 3 and no more than 6 — one half of the desk's loyalty relief is taken off the figure reached, that is 50 per cent of the relief, being 1.5 per cent of the figure.

**And otherwise?** Where the club ledger shows 3 packages or fewer booked in the last thirty-six months, nothing is taken off the figure reached under this note.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

On a figure reached of 2,000.00 USD, a traveller whose club ledger shows 7 packages booked in the last thirty-six months has 3 per cent taken off, being 60.00 USD, leaving 1,940.00 USD. A traveller whose club ledger shows 5 packages has 1.5 per cent taken off, being 30.00 USD, leaving 1,970.00 USD. A traveller whose club ledger shows 2 packages has nothing taken off, and the 2,000.00 USD stands.

A traveller at exactly 6 packages is not more than twice the threshold and so takes the half relief; a traveller at exactly 3 packages is not more than the threshold and so takes none.
